scope: PROP-FLOOD-07.v1 (registry/proposals/flood_flow_state.json): one NEW method-domain (M) proposal for a community flood-readout application (FloodConnect), via the governed proposals-lane intake process -- NOT promoted into registry/CANONICAL.json. Registers a flow-state classifier (F1-F6) for a connected water-chain edge, extracting the vocabulary/typology from thailand_flood_kg/docs/FLOW_STALL_TYPOLOGY.md sec.8 (a founder-relayed external-assistant candidate, tagged there RELAYED-external-proposal / adopted-as-convention for vocabulary only, explicitly NOT registered by that document's own worker, whose sec.8 states in full: 'ยังไม่ผ่าน Toledo, ห้ามอ้างเป็นทฤษฎีบท ... ผู้ที่จะเปิด Toledo PR ต้องอ่าน toledo/EQUATION_SOURCE_POLICY.md ก่อน ... ไม่ใช่งานของ worker นี้' -- this registration is that follow-on step). Toledo lookup confirmed no existing object classifies flow states (PROP-FLOOD-04 gives edge direction only, PROP-FLOOD-01 gives node trend only, PROP-FLOOD-05a/b classifies burden-side not flow-state) -- gap confirmed, PROPOSAL not REUSE. Fresh Genesis-compatibility check performed (readout_genesis Part V-A A.13 'Gate 2 -- Three-Valued Admissibility', same gate PROP-FLOOD-01/04 already cite, needed fresh because this object composes two already-compatible sources plus two new inputs (control-fault state, community report) and introduces a genuinely new third coverage-state, Inferred, that neither parent's own admissibility mapping covered). The object: four collapsed inputs D (PROP-FLOOD-04's direction, 4-valued), T (PROP-FLOOD-01's trend at the far/receiving node, 4-valued, STALLED read from a persistent FLAT per thailand_flood_kg's own _is_persistently_stalled windowed convention), C (declared control-structure state, 5-valued, adds a NEW value FAULT to PROP-FLOOD-05a's OPEN/CLOSED/PUMPING vocabulary), M (a RELAYED community surface-state report, 5-valued) -- collapsed via a fixed 10-row total decision table (refusal checked first: REFUSED(NO_INPUT) iff all four ABSENT; else community BACKFLOW forces F5; else D=REVERSE gives F4; else D=FORWARD splits by T into F1/F2/F3, with a fault-veto restricted to F1/F2 only per founder rule 5 verbatim ('ปั๊ม/ประตูขัดข้อง (fault) -> ... ห้ามพูดว่าตามทฤษฎีน้ำไหลได้') -- F3 (blocked) is deliberately NOT vetoed by a control fault, since gradient-without-progress is itself consistent with, not contradicted by, a faulted structure; else D=UNRESOLVED or D=ABSENT (with some other input present) give F6 with a stated ruled_out subset of {F1..F5}, never REFUSED and never a bare unlabeled '?'). This directly implements the founder's own correction received mid-registration on the parent object's v5 pass ('อย่าลืมว่าไม่มีทางมีข้อมูลพอ แต่ใช้การอนุมานจากข้อมูลที่แข็งแรงเป็นหลัก') -- REFUSED is the last resort, never the default for an un-instrumented edge. Additionally registers, as a GENERIC reusable primitive (not scoped to this object alone), the 'inferred' third coverage-state (coverage3: Present/Absent/Inferred; a generic inferred_value(A) record carrying a value, an ordinal confidence = the MINIMUM -- never average -- of the cited anchors' own evidence strengths per thailand_flood_kg's FLOW_STALL_TYPOLOGY.md sec.3 five-rung ladder, and an anchors list) that PROP-FLOOD-06.v5's own honest_caveats explicitly deferred to a 'v6' pass -- implemented HERE, in its own object, per this repository's Toledo-first reuse gate (EQUATION_SOURCE_POLICY.md TG-RFG-01: a genuinely new primitive needs its own lookup/Genesis-compatibility pass before derivation, not a silent fold into an unrelated object's next version bump), together with RULE-STALL-01 (far anchor persistently STALLED + zero pumps + community 'not yet falling' => infer the intervening run STALLED) and RULE-DIR-01 (two bounding anchors agree in direction => infer the intervening run moves the same direction) as declared consistency rules producing an Inferred value, each proved well-formed (rule_stall_01_wf, rule_dir_01_wf). RULE-COMMUNITY-01 is explicitly NOT formalised as a third inferred_value producer -- it is already the M input itself (a first-class RELAYED input the decision table already consults), stated so this typology term is not silently dropped. HONEST FINDING, disclosed rather than hidden: the general claim 'adding inputs never un-rules an already ruled-out class' is FALSE for this classifier once the two overriding rows (community BACKFLOW forcing F5; control FAULT vetoing F1/F2) are allowed to fire -- both can retract a previously-asserted determinate class once new, contradicting information arrives (demonstrated as an explicit Coq counterexample, monotonicity_fails_on_fault_veto: a forward-gradient+falling-trend edge asserted F1 with ruled_out={F2,F3,F4,F5} is downgraded to F6 with ruled_out={F1,F2} -- F1 itself newly ruled out -- purely by later learning the control structure is FAULT). Per this task's own instruction and this repository's AGENTS.md counterexample-recording discipline, the monotonicity theorem actually proved (flow_ruled_out_monotone) is correspondingly RESTRICTED: it holds only while community stays not-BACKFLOW and control stays not-FAULT on both sides of the comparison -- i.e. revealing only D/T information (never a value change, only Absent->known) never un-rules a previously ruled-out class; the unrestricted version is not claimed. coq/canonical/PROP_FLOOD_07_flow_state.v: totality (classify_total, plus Coq's own exhaustive-match totality check), decidable equality for every input enum and for the flow_class6/flow_result output types, refused_iff_all_absent (an iff, exactly as asked: REFUSED iff all four inputs absent) and its corollary classify_never_refused_when_present (F6, not REFUSED, whenever any input is present), the restricted monotonicity theorem plus its any_present_mono and ctrl_is_fault_false_of_neq helper lemmas, the two inference-rule well-formedness lemmas, the coverage3 ordering facts (coverage3_rank_absent_lt_inferred, coverage3_rank_inferred_le_present, coverage3_promote_never_lowers_rank -- the reusable fact a future PROP-FLOOD-06.v6 needs for its own 'inferred->present never lowers the tier' theorem), and 8 worked Examples spot-checking the decision table row-by-row plus both inference rules firing. No entries in registry/CANONICAL.json touched; thailand_flood_kg (a separate, read-only-with-respect-to-this-repo project) is not touched by this change -- its FLOW_STALL_TYPOLOGY.md sec.8 is read but not edited. No claim about the Clay Millennium Navier-Stokes problem, or about any object's Clay/NS status, is made or implied anywhere in this change; the status of every existing Clay-related registry object (CANONICAL.json, coq/canonical/ pre-existing files, docs/CLAY_*) is unchanged.
